lines.name: l1
lines.text: You'll remember this video longer if I don't finish it.

lines.name: l3
lines.text: In the nineteen twenties, psychologist Bluma Zeigarnik noticed that waiters remembered unpaid orders perfectly, and forgot them the moment the bill was paid.

lines.name: l4
lines.text: Your brain keeps unfinished tasks open, like tabs in a browser.

lines.name: l5
lines.text: That's why cliffhangers work. And why one tiny task can keep you awake at night.
